stories.title: Bessent threatens Iran secondary sanctions, says Trump is asking world leaders to cooperate
stories.reason: Trump is personally calling world leaders to cut Iran trade, and the administration's restraint toward Chinese firms ahead of Xi's Washington visit is drawing scrutiny.

stories.title: Supreme Court hands preliminary win to Trump on mail-in ballots executive order
stories.reason: A 6-3 ruling lifted an injunction blocking parts of Trump's order restricting mail ballots, though the underlying legal fight continues ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Nvidia earnings: live updates and commentary
stories.reason: Nvidia reports fiscal Q2 results after today's close with analysts expecting $92.2 billion in revenue, a result that will move valuations across the entire AI trade.

stories.title: Stock market today: live updates
stories.reason: The Dow notched a third straight winning session, but futures wobbled ahead of Nvidia's earnings as investors weigh the AI trade's next catalyst.

stories.title: Fully AI-generated music to be banned from ARIA charts
stories.reason: Australia's national chart body becomes an early mover in defining what counts as human-made music as generative AI reshapes the industry.
